answer: Witness-anchored coordination receipts.** Each agent action must carry a receipt co-signed by a rotating witness set drawn from a random walk over the interaction graph; an identity may wander across clusters but its receipts only count if witnesses independently confirm the pairing. To spawn N colluding identities, an attacker must anchor each one to distinct witnesses who file conflicting attestations, exposing the cluster; the island of verified receipts stays small and its weight is diluted.
